title: Yeimar bar Chasho
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Ketubot 84b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.84b) relates that he was owed money by a certain man who died and left a boat. Yeimar bar Chasho went and told his agent to seize the boat in payment of his debt. Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua met him (the agent) and told him that he had not acquired it, because he was seizing property on behalf of one creditor to the detriment of others.[^1]

notes.text: The parenthesis “the agent” belongs to the person whom the sages met, not to the sages themselves. ר״פ and ר״ה בריה דרב יהושע are expanded contextually as Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua; no authority identity is assigned. בע״ח means a creditor. The printed Ketubot locator פד: is read conventionally as 84b and has not been independently verified.
